title: A plain typed override ask lifts a refusal, as the plain Opus ask does
why: Owner ask, 12:44 CST Nov 7 (page ask ask-mw6r5ldefg): in other sessions only the bare `override` or `override 15m` works, though he thought overriding was made more dynamic. Only the Opus refusal got a plain-word route (step opus-plain-ask, #1204, #1208). The general override is still keyword-only: decision owner-override says `override 15m please` grants nothing, so an intended `off` never becomes a grant.
note: Owner asked 13:13 CST Nov 7 whether this fell off the map; triage asked the coordinator to start its lane now. Shape: extend the one home, hooks/override.py and the plain-ask judge in call_judge.py, so a plain owner ask such as `go ahead and override that for 15 min` grants the same one-act or timed override. Keep the fail-closed guards of the Opus route: owner-typed prompt only, pasted and notice blocks cut, questions, hedges and negations grant nothing, judge error grants nothing. The 10-minute expiry of an unused one-act override stays. Departs from: decision owner-override (keyword forms only for `override`) — adds a judged plain-word route. Rewrites that record in place; the owner sees the rewrite in the PR. Done: a red test for `override that for 15 minutes please` granting 15 min, and for `don't override` and `should I override?` granting nothing, then green. Built in #1463 (head 3b8fa68fc), with runner 8 to merge (coordinator, 14:29 CST Nov 7). After #1463 and #2220 merge, from #1463's round 3 (coordinator 21:07 CST Nov 8), each pointing to decision owner-override: (1) note override-negation-words: the plain ask's negation list lacks won't, can't, cannot, stop, cancel, revoke (hooks/override.py); only the judge stops `stop the override for 15 minutes`. (2) note override-ask-any-length, already filed. (3) step owner-override-later-line-text. (4) note override-gate-word: "gate"/"gates" (GLOSSARY Not cell) in hooks/override.py, owner-override.md, call_judge.py, local_time.py. Done: #1463 and #2220 merged in batch 68 (#2449, 8bc28980b, 11:55 CST Nov 9). Answered 18:29 CST Nov 13: owner 778 a, ruling own-778-a-reword-offer-for-lane. Reword the line for a lane.
